process.label: process
process._note: ETP-6148 — «Procesar»: RemittanceHeaderHandler action `process` (runs REM's REMRemittanceProcess). The params dialog asks the grouping (default P «Sin agrupar», GGPD «Agrupar por cliente y vencimiento») and posts it as fieldValues.grouping. Only while unprocessed and with lines.

reactivate.label: reactivate
reactivate._note: ETP-6148 — «Reactivar»: RemittanceHeaderHandler action `reactivate` (deletes the payments the process created; the remittance becomes editable again). Danger style, so DetailView asks for confirmation through customComponents.processConfirmModal (RemittanceProcessConfirmModal).

transactionDate.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Fecha' (Datetrx): the remittance date. Mandatory, but never typed by the user: NeoMandatoryDefaultsService injects the AD default (@#Date@, today) on create, and the remittance handler may set it explicitly.

remittanceType.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Tipo de remesa' (REM_Remittance_Type_ID). Its identifier already reads 'Remesa de cobro' / 'Remesa de pago', so it covers both the direction (collection/payment) and the SEPA scheme in the list without a derived column. Cascades on financialAccount: the selector request carries FIN_Financial_Account_ID and the remittance handler only offers the types whose SEPA scheme is enabled on that account.

name.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Nombre' (Name). Mandatory, max 60 characters (validated by the remittance handler). The AD field has no read-only logic, so readOnlyLogic @Processed@='Y' locks it on a processed remittance like the other header fields; the remittance handler already refuses that edit (422 ETGO_RemittanceProcessedNotEditable).

financialAccount.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Cuenta' (FIN_Financial_Account_ID). The selector is served by the remittance handler and only offers accounts with EM_ETGO_Allow_Remittance = Y. Placed first in the form because remittanceType depends on it. List: columnWidth 290 fits a typical account name («Cuenta Remesa ETP-6148 - EUR»); `name` absorbs the leftover width (grow), not the account or the type (user decision 2026-11-06).

dueDate.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Fecha de cargo/abono' (Duedate): the date the bank charges (collection) or credits (payment) the remittance. minDate today: the picker disables past days and a typed past date blocks the save (only a NEW value is checked, so an existing remittance with a past date still opens and saves); RemittanceHeaderHandler refuses the same with 422 ETGO_RemittanceDueDatePast.

remittanceStatus.label: Status
remittanceStatus.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Estado' (Remittance_Status, DAL property remittanceStatus, list REM_RemittanceStatus: PE, PR, CT, PT, CP, PP, AN). A column of the remittance module itself (added in ETP-6148 on feature/ETP-6148; the remittance PR must be merged and its module built before this change is deployed), set by REM's own processes; never written by the user. form:false: the header shows the status only as the top-bar pill (statusField), not as a form field. enumValues points every code at an i18n key (genericLabels remittanceStatusPe…An), because the AD list ships English names only and the read-only form select would otherwise show 'Pending' in Spanish; window.statusEnumLabels does the same for the detail status pill. enumVariants gives the grid badge and the status quick filter their per-code tones (PE neutral, PR info, CT/PT success, CP/PP warning, AN destructive); the codes are too ambiguous across windows for the global getStatusTone catalog.

documentNo.reason: ETP-6148 — «Nº documento» (DocumentNo): assigned by the server from the REM_REM document type sequence; shown, never typed. First list column (a real column: sorts and filters on the server) and first header field, by user decision (2026-11-06).

documentType.reason: ETP-6148 — C_Doctype_ID, the client's REM_REM document type. Mandatory; resolved server-side (AD default @SQL ... DocBaseType = 'REM_REM', or the remittance handler defaults).

processed.reason: ETP-6148 — kept in the payload (not shown) because every header field's readOnlyLogic is @Processed@='Y': a processed remittance is locked.

chargedate.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic 'Discount Date', only meaningful for discount (consolidated) remittance types, which Etendo GO does not offer.

singlePayment.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic technical flag (one payment per remittance); NOT NULL with DB default 'N'.

payment.reason: ETP-6148 — the single payment generated by Classic when singlePayment = Y; not used.

selectpayments.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic process button, out of scope (selection of due items is a later task). Discarded so NEO and MCP do not expose the action; processOverrides excludes it too.

createLinesFrom.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic process button, out of scope.

getFile.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic 'Create Remittance File', out of scope (the SEPA XML is built by another team).

processRemittance.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic 'Process Remittance', out of scope (status transitions are a later task).

selectInvoicesAndOrders.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic process button, out of scope.

posted.reason: ETP-6148 — accounting button; remittance types are provisioned with ISPOSTINGALLOWED = N.

lines._methodsNote: ETP-6148 — lines are added only through «Seleccionar desde factura» (no POST/PUT/PATCH, every field readOnly, so DetailView shows no add-line area and no edit). DELETE enables the generic line delete (row trash icon + selection bar); DetailView hides it on a processed remittance (lockWhenProcessed) and RemittanceLinesHandler refuses it there too.

lineNo.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Línea' (Line). Hidden from the Lines tab by user decision (2026-11-06); kept readOnly (still served) because the lines keep their default order by line number.

paymentScheduleDetail.label: Due Item
paymentScheduleDetail.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Vencimiento' (FIN_Payment_Scheduledetail_ID). TEMPORARY first column (user decision 2026-11-06) until the generic Classic property-path fields land: its AD identifier reads «due date - installment amount - line amount». The target is separate Factura / Cliente / Vencimiento fields through property paths. It grows because it always has a value.

payment.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Pago' (FIN_Payment_ID). Hidden on the Lines tab (user decision 2026-11-06, option a): a line created from an invoice due amount has no payment until the remittance is processed, and the grid cannot hide a column based on the header's processed state. Still served.

amount.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Importe'. currencyField names the line's own text currency (REM's SQL-logic Currency, e.g. EUR), which resolveRowCurrency accepts as a plain ISO code, so the cell reads «53,24 €» with the line currency.

invoice.reason: ETP-6148 — AD_Field property path paymentScheduleDetail.invoicePaymentSchedule.invoice (anchor FIN_Payment_Schedule.C_Invoice_ID). Not supported end to end (checked for ETP-6148): the extractor ignores AD_Field.Property and emits the anchor column of the joined table (here C_Invoice_ID) as a flat key; push-to-neo only matches columns of REM_RemittanceLine, so the field is skipped; NeoFieldFilter resolves fields with getPropertyByColumnName on RemittanceLine, so NEO never serves it. Enabling it would render an always-empty, unfilterable column.

invoicePaymentSchedule.reason: ETP-6148 — AD_Field property path paymentScheduleDetail.invoicePaymentSchedule (anchor FIN_Payment_ScheduleDetail.FIN_Payment_Schedule_Invoice; its identifier is the due date and amount). Not supported end to end (checked for ETP-6148): the extractor ignores AD_Field.Property and emits the anchor column of the joined table (here FIN_Payment_Schedule_Invoice) as a flat key; push-to-neo only matches columns of REM_RemittanceLine, so the field is skipped; NeoFieldFilter resolves fields with getPropertyByColumnName on RemittanceLine, so NEO never serves it. Enabling it would render an always-empty, unfilterable column.

orderPaymentInPlan.reason: ETP-6148 — virtual (SQL logic) column of the order payment plan; payment-plan fields are hidden from the Lines tab and remittances of orders are not offered.

currency.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Moneda' (Currency): REM's virtual SQL-logic column on REM_RemittanceLine. Not a column of its own any more: the amount is formatted with it (amount.currencyField). Still served.

origstatus.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic technical column (payment status before remitting).
